question: Free remote compute with datacenter internet for batch-2 transcription, after Azure free credit exhausted and Google AI Pro credits ruled out by operator.
why_remote: Operator confirmed internet speed was an independent reason for choosing a VM, not just disk space. Per-file fetch solved the 320 GB disk problem (evidence: nhbplus-perfile-fetch-solved-2026-10-15.json) but NOT the bandwidth problem — ~180 GiB must traverse a datacenter link, not the operator's home connection.

updated_requirement.runtime: ~3-5 h continuous (fetch ~3.4 h for 180 GiB at 15.8 MB/s + STT ~25 min)
updated_requirement.platform: Linux x86_64, root, megacmd .deb, ffmpeg, python3
updated_requirement.network: datacenter egress to mega.nz and api.eu.deepgram.com

options_scored.name: GitHub Codespaces
options_scored.free: 120 core-hours/month on personal account = 60 h on a 2-core machine; 15 GB storage
options_scored.fit: STRONG — datacenter internet, root in devcontainer, apt install megacmd, 60 h >> ~5 h needed, 15 GB >> 4 GiB peak
options_scored.blocker: gh CLI authenticated as ao-kamal but token lacks 'codespace' scope. Needs `gh auth refresh -h github.com -s codespace` (interactive) — an operator action.
options_scored.unproven: MEGA and api.eu.deepgram.com reachability from a codespace; megacmd .deb install in devcontainer. Must probe before build.

options_scored.name: Azure — new free trial
options_scored.fit: The prior 30-day trial (started 2026-10-14) has simply EXPIRED by time at 2026-11-23 (40 days), which is the likely reason for 'credit used up' rather than actual compute spend (~$0.21/day idle).
options_scored.blocker: One free account per person; a new trial requires new identity/payment details and the tenant security-defaults block (AADSTS530035) still prevents provisioning. Not legitimate to create a second free account.

options_scored.name: Oracle Cloud Always Free
options_scored.free: 2 OCPU / 12 GB ARM, 200 GB block, 10 TB egress, forever
options_scored.blocker: Operator's prior signup failed (per 2026-10-14 artifact). Oracle rejects PIN debit / virtual / prepaid cards; Nov 2026 report of a Nigerian user with a verified Mastercard still failing at account creation. Region-based rejection is likely, not card-based.

options_scored.name: Railway anonymous free VM
options_scored.free: 2 vCPU / 2 GB RAM, no card, no account
options_scored.blocker: 2 GB RAM insufficient; 60 min build + 24 h claim window; unclaimed boxes deleted. Too short for ~5 h.

options_scored.name: InstaBox
options_scored.free: 4 vCPU / 8 GB / 20 GB, Google or GitHub login, no card
options_scored.blocker: 8 h continuous max, 30 min idle sleep — too short/risky for a ~5 h unattended fetch; service maturity unverified.

options_scored.name: Local WSL
options_scored.free: yes — tools already present (ffmpeg, ffprobe, python3, mega-get), 924 GB disk, sudo
options_scored.blocker: Operator ruled out: home internet cannot carry ~180 GiB. This was an independent design reason for the VM.

recommendation: GitHub Codespaces — the only option with datacenter bandwidth, no card, enough hours, and an already-authenticated GitHub account. One interactive scope refresh required, then live probe before build.
operator_action_required: Run `gh auth refresh -h github.com -s codespace` (opens browser once). Then say 'refreshed' and I will provision a codespace and probe MEGA + Deepgram reachability before committing to the run.
proof_class: DOCUMENTARY_ONLY — no provider account was created, no compute provisioned, no claims about reachability are proven.
